content: Dynamic resolution rendering: render the fragment shader to an offscreen framebuffer at a fraction (0.5x-0.75x) of native resolution, then upscale to the full-screen quad. This reduces fragment-shader invocations proportionally (0.5x = 0.25x the pixels) with minimal perceptual loss on smooth liquid gradients (aliasing only matters at hard edges). DPR clamping to 2 is a baseline; combine with a quality scale factor that can adapt down to 1.0 or 0.5 on low-power GPUs. Pass u_resolution as the actual drawing-buffer size so the shader's noise UVs stay correct. ResizeObserver (not just window resize) handles container-driven layouts.
